statement: A friendly, uncluttered Sudoku game on a single web page for casual players who play quick games on their phone, with difficulty levels and beginner help that does not spoil the puzzle, and with no sign-up and no ads.
audience: Casual players who play a quick game on their phone, for example on a commute, including beginners.
standards: Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
Friendly, calm look that is less cluttered than typical Sudoku sites
Works on a 360px phone screen and a 1280px desktop screen
rules: No sign-up or login of any kind
Invent no contact details, numbers or claims that are not in the brief
Hints must never reveal the digit for a cell
done_when: Cozy Sudoku's page shows the name Cozy Sudoku as its title and main heading
Cozy Sudoku is a single HTML file with its CSS and JavaScript inside it, with no sign-up or login form and no ads
Cozy Sudoku's page shows a 9 by 9 board with some digits given, and a visitor can select an empty cell and enter a digit from 1 to 9 by tapping
Cozy Sudoku's page offers Easy, Medium and Hard difficulty levels, and choosing one starts a new puzzle of that level
Cozy Sudoku's board has a notes mode where a visitor can pencil small candidate digits into a cell
Cozy Sudoku's page has an undo button that reverses the visitor's last move
Cozy Sudoku's page has a hint button that points the visitor to a cell to look at without showing the digit that belongs in it
Cozy Sudoku's board highlights a digit that repeats in the same row, column or box
Cozy Sudoku saves an unfinished game in the browser so a returning visitor can resume it or start a new one
Cozy Sudoku's page shows a friendly win message when the board is correctly completed
Cozy Sudoku's page shows only the board, the controls and short messages, with no other element
Cozy Sudoku's page has no horizontal overflow at 360px and at 1280px widths and its buttons are easy to tap
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: Start a quick game right away with no sign-up
Get beginner help that does not spoil the puzzle
